summary: First full run. Backend: 34 pytest tests (permission matrix for all 8 seeded accounts/6 roles across startups/users/organizations/service-profiles/lookups/alerts, provider isolation incl. 2nd provider, ADMIN_STARTUP invite scoping, codice_breve validation/uniqueness, servizi rules, delete rules 409 with startup list, event visibility ALL vs NURSERY_ONLY with split events, invite flow/regenerate/used/expired/cancel, self/last-admin rules, alerts, profile & password, bcrypt, brute-force lock) - ALL PASS. Frontend (Playwright): login, startup list/search/detail/tabs/Cronologia, create startup form with servizi-rule toast, invite from startup -> link dialog -> copy -> /invito/{token} set password -> logged in to /mia-startup, reused link error, regenerate from Users page invalidates old link, cancel invite, Segnalazioni page, ADMIN_STARTUP home with Impresa Digitale + Modifica contatti (OPERATIVO_STARTUP has none), provider nav/list/404 page, Area personale profile + password change, provider delete blocked toast, startup delete (ONBOARDING), mobile 390px for main pages (no horizontal overflow) - ALL WORKING.

minor.issue: Duplicate codice_breve returns 422 while permissions.md says rule conflicts are 409 (message itself is correct: 'Il codice breve ALFA è già usato da ...').

Last-active-ADMIN_STARTUP 409 check (assert_not_last_admin) is effectively unreachable: actor must be an active ADMIN_STARTUP of the same org (so 'others' >= 1) and self-operations are blocked earlier with 403. Behaviour is safe, but the 409 path can never fire; verified self-demote/deactivate -> 403 and demoting another admin while actor stays admin -> 200.

ADMIN_STARTUP inviting into Nursery/Provider org with a role not matching org type gets 422 ('ruolo non compatibile') instead of 403 because role compatibility is checked before permission; with a matching role it correctly returns 403.
data_chiusura_esercizio regex accepts impossible dates like 02-31 / 04-31.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True (auth is Bearer header/localStorage, no httpOnly cookies). Acceptable for prototype; playbook expects explicit origins + httpOnly cookies.

ui_bugs.issue: Alerts for startups that were later soft-deleted still render a link to /startup/{id}, which leads to 'Startup non trovata'. Consider marking as 'eliminata' / no link (backend alerts could add startup_deleted flag).

issues: Data di costituzione / Data iscrizione use native <input type='date'> browser picker instead of shadcn Calendar/DatePicker (inconsistent styling).
Sonner toast overlaps header action buttons (e.g. 'Modifica contatti', 'Nuovo provider') while visible; consider bottom-right or offset.

critical_code_review_comments: Permission logic is centralised and correct (startup_scope, can_manage, get_visible_startup -> 404).
log_changes correctly splits sensitive vs ordinary fields into NURSERY_ONLY/ALL events - verified.
list_profiles/list_orgs do N+1 count_documents per row - fine at this scale.
Invite email uniqueness check includes soft-deleted users (cannot re-invite an email of a deleted startup) - may be intended.
test_credentials: From /app/memory/test_credentials.md - all 8 accounts logged in successfully. Seeded passwords untouched.

ALFA telefono changed and reverted to empty.

Tests create & clean up their own TEST data. Lockout test uses a random non-seeded email. Note screenshot paths with f-strings break the browser tool - use static names.
